envelope.reason: The notebook now distinguishes resolution from retraction. The note's whole-state payload must name its carrier; the approved resolved-notes realization already does. This clarification was held until suggestions-as-notes closed so its pinned design stayed fixed.
envelope.cause: held decision: a resolved note's payload names its carrier; closed suggestions-as-notes

payload.gloss: the whole state of the entity as of this record; never a delta. A concept's payload is its anchor, gloss and factors; a plan's is its name, the concepts it realizes and its lifecycle state; a unit's is its plan, full spec and lifecycle state; a note's is its title, kind, topic, body and whatever it blocks, and, when resolved, the concept or unit that now carries it.
